steps.text: Weekend
Rhodes Island Cafeteria

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: And so, just like that—

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: And your cards naturally fall like water from one hand—

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Into the other.

steps.name: Young Studying Operator
steps.text: Wow!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Do you know how?

steps.name: Young Studying Operator
steps.text: I still don't!!

steps.name: Young Studying Operator
steps.text: Do it again, Gitano!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: *clears throat* Now, watch carefully.

steps.name: Young Studying Operator
steps.text: Okay—

steps.name: Young Studying Operator
steps.text: Wow!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Do you understand now?

steps.name: Young Studying Operator
steps.text: Nooope—

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Regrettably, however, that's the end of today's cardistry lesson.

steps.name: Young Studying Operator
steps.text: Awww—

steps.name: Young Studying Operator
steps.text: How about one more time?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Then the person teaching here in a short while will be quite angry with me.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: You wouldn't want to see me get castigated, would you?

steps.name: Young Studying Operator
steps.text: Just one more, one little bit more? It'll be okay, right?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Rules are very important. You cannot let your desires lead you to willingly abandon them.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Hmm—

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Such as it is, I'll give you all some homework.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: If anyone can show us the fruits of their practice by next week's lesson...

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Then—

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: You may draw one reward from the teacher's Treasure Chest.

steps.name: Young Studying Operator
steps.text: The Treasure Chest?

steps.name: Young Studying Operator
steps.text: Really?!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Really and truly. Just two days ago, your teacher even added something quite fun to it.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: As long as you can summon the courage to give us all a display, everyone will get a share.

steps.name: Young Studying Operator
steps.text: Yay!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Alright, class dismissed. Don't forget, keep your cards and toys safe with you.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: We'll meet next week.

steps.name: Young Studying Operator
steps.text: Bye, Miss!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Phewie and a half. Breathe easy, miss. Lessons still runnin' slick?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: You might get the impression they're lessons, but it's really just entertaining the children.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: You have the greater burden.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: It takes quite a lot of brainpower and effort, teaching children the rules of arithmetic.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ain't no nightmare, really. Play numbers long 'nuff 'n they get it.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: 'n what I teach ain't no mathematics. Umm, what was that name I picked it?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: 'Business Fanatics Class?' Somethin' like that.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Aw, shucks, I'm just the same as you. Three cheers fer fun 'n none fer learnin'.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: And that's quite good.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: After all, it's a very cruel thing, doing business.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You get me, ma'am.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Though it was never originally intended as such, divination is also fundamentally a sort of business.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: So it goes.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: I'll let you set up the classroom in peace, then. Farewell.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hrmmm—

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oh, right!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Gitano, one second, please!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Do you need anything?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: It's like this, see. Doctor seems fixin' ta head out far with Gavial, makin' fer a corner of Sargon.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: And me, I'm gettin' ready to visit with, see if I can't do a li'l dealin' while I'm there.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Yes, I follow.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: So I thought, uh. Y'see, uh. If you could juuuuust do me a li'l favor, gimme a tellin'?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: You ought to know—

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I know there is, yep, just, urm, how do I break this—

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Spent all my money on gettin' stock in, ha, and now I ain't got a red cent on me.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: I won't take any money as compensation.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ya serious? That's mighty fine!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: But I will need you to promise something.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: You must promise me this—

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: You will not sell anything to the children during class.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Not even if it's 'just snacks.'

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Uh, haha.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Aw, heck, what makes you think I'd do somethin' like that?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Class might be a circus, but I still teach 'em proper.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: You might, you might not. Neither has any bearing on me.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: I simply need your promise, and that will be my price.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: 'n if I go back on it?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Who knows?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: What do you think?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sold!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: I have accepted your payment.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: No need fer a... contract or somesuch?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Our agreement is built upon our trust in each other. We need no contract.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: In that case, let us begin.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Considering class is about to start, we'll employ a more simple divination method.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: (Pulls out tarot deck)

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Whoa, that's... some crafts, ain't it!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Feels like every card in there'd fetch big money.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Way you spread out 'n spin' 'em on the table, is that shufflin'?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Yes. Please wait a moment.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Could just shuffle 'em fancy in one shot, like you were teachin'.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Some diviners will do it like that, true.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: But it's too harmful to the cards.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Just like the voyager pushing stubbornly through a blizzard: no matter how healthy, or how warm the clothes, their warmth is pulled away trace by trace in the end.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: The moment warmth is lost, all remedy will be of avail no more.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ahaha...

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Just a comparison Sami tend to use fairly often. I imagine you comprehend it.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Yup, yup, I getcha.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: All ready now?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Mm. They're ready. They should be able to shine a light for you on some of your conundrums.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Gather them together, cut them once, and starting from where you've cut them, lay down three cards.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Remember, do not turn them over yet.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: So ya don't actually do a darn thing, Gitano?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: I'm merely your guide in understanding. Shouldn't you uncover your own fate?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Or, perhaps, you're easily willing to lay your fate in others' hands?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Alrght, I get it now. Lemme at 'em!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Stack 'em up... cut... lay three cards face down in front.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That oughta be good, right?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Your movements are very direct. It seems you are not adrift.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Darn tootin'.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Well, then. Please.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Turn a card however you wish.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ya been so dead serious all this time. Got some pressure on me.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: There's nothing to be scared of. Come.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Reveal your first card.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: (Flips card)

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: The Knight of Cups, Reversed.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ya gotta fill me in. Does forward or backward matter anythin'?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: To put it simply, reversed cards symbolize that you are currently hindered by something.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Relax. These hindrances are not necessarily bad in meaning.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: They simply mean that right now, you are unable to successfully proceed.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Breakthrough, and success, perhaps aren't too far away.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Gotcha.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Let me look carefully.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Have you run into any problems doing business?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Uh, suppose I have.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That's how it goes more or less every month. Sometimes I blunder decidin', 'n then I don't earn nothin.' Pain in my keister.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: You've probably seen an opportunity, but failed to grasp it.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That's the story of anyone doin' business any day of the week.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: So this time, you've prepared to stake it all?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I trust my intuition. Headin' to Gavial's ol' place is gonna pay off big!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: By my understanding, Rhodes Island's procurement services have always been short of hands. As long as you're willing to help them with some work, money won't be a problem, and most risk will be shouldered by Rhodes Island instead.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Why choose to go it alone?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: That, huh.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Used to workin' by myself.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: It seems your decisions are not wholly profit-seeking.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ain't as grand as ya put it, neither. Just seein' the world fer myself, makin' some money on the side to patch up expenses.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Always gotta spend money fer the good stuff, after all.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: So this, uh, this here card, basically, it ain't no good sign.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Coming events will not be smooth.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: So can I just—Gitano—ya gotta teach me!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Don't rush. This is merely a beginning.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Come. Reveal your second card.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: D'awwwgh, alright...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: (Shakes as she flips a card)

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: The Ace of Wands, Upright.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Wh... what's this one mean...?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: You have seized an opportunity, and are about to receive an advantage in life from it.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Though there may be great danger, you have issued your challenge to life with full conviction.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sounds like a good thing.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: When I divined for myself, I once came to this one too.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Whoa—y'all can even do divination fer yerselves?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: When a flash of miraculous light strikes, diviners are utterly capable of peering into their own paths.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: 'n here I thought diviners only took money 'n did stuff fer other folk.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Ultimately, currency cannot settle all questions.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Moreover, there are some paths outsiders have no recourse to interfere in. Only by conversing with themselves, feeling through things, pursuing, can they grasp a chance at a clue.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Gets pretty darn complicated, then.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: It's just like how you choose to conduct business by yourself, Croissant. All your decisions, any of your choices, they're all crystallizations of your years of business experience, aren't they?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Others can only give suggestions. The power to decide lies eternally in your own hand—just as it does now.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Even if all three cards portended the worst outcome, would you really change your decisions?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Money's spent...

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: So you've only come seeking a comfort of sorts, hoping I might give you reassuring results.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Ah—no need to answer me. Many are like that. I understand it very well.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: All of us will tend to hope for something unrealistic in uncertain times, something that'll resolve it all.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Unfortunately, I'm not what you've all been hoping for.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: All I can do is peer shallow into the road ahead, and offer all the help I can.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: You've paid my terms, and so I have a responsibility to spare no effort for you.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Only this, and nothing more.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Gitano...

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Let us continue.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Al... Alrighty.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: You will have an adventure, but it seems your journey won't be serene.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: As for the outcome, we may look to the last card to show our answer.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: I can't say whether there'll even be a single note of LMD at the end.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: It just keeps gettin' more dangerous...

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: I only bring up a poorer kind of possibility.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Returning with overflowing riches is not out of possibility's realm, either.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Gosh, could ya imagine?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: I'll be visiting Perfumer's sometime for a complete course of aromatic sleep therapy, then.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: I'll leave the bill to you.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I make some cash 'n I'll cover ya!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Hm-hmm. It's a done deal.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Now, then, let us explore your destination in this journey.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Your final card, please.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: (Flips tarot card with a swish)

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: The Moons, Upright.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: So it's upright. 'kay, good start.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: This is... certainly hard to say.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Have... you ever looked into Gavial's hometown situation before?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I've surveyed Sargon markets before. This stuff'll sell like hotcakes!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: If so, that'll be the best outcome.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: (Is there any possibility it won't be an ordinary Sargon market, I wonder...)

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: (The Moons upright...)

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Your journey will not be serene. The fore cards tell of that much.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Be wary of deception, and wary of being cheated.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: In my view, if possible, do proceed cautiously.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Do you like the moons?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Like? Can't say I do fer sure? But when I'm moody out on the deck 'n look up 'n see the moons, that makes me feel alright some.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: And the moonshadow?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Umm. Do folk specifically go lookin' fer the shadow?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Under the radiance of the moon, things often come to be ignored.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: The things this card shows are also as such.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: There is always that which is hidden by radiance, painstakingly concealed.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Whether it is fortune or sorrow requires your own careful consideration.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Noted. I'll be watchin' out.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: And this should be what these cards have shown.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: What these three cards together make known to you.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Croissant, your future will not be relaxed.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: At the least, accompanying the Doctor on this journey out, there will be many hindrances.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Do you have any such feeling of your own? For example, a vague unease or confusion in your heart.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Kinda a li'l bit...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: But push past, 'n I should be able to get over it.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Do the, uh, cards say I'm gonna lose my investment?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Not at all. Besides, the tarot never speaks in certainties of futures.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: So, still a chance I'm saved.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: If I can't hold out, I oughta last 'nother couple days knockin' on my savin's jar.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Here's hoping.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: As for divining, things would wrap up here.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Is there anything else you need me for?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Gitano, you pull a card too!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Didn'tcha just say diviners can divine themselves too?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I wanna see how yer luck is.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: But that requires me to prepare—

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: C'mon, lessee.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: The tarot is not—

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Aw, potayto potahto, c'mon. Draw.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: (Draws a card 'for' Gitano.)

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Come on. Flip it.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Wait. Let me prepare a moment.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Phew.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: (Flips tarot card)

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Ten of Cups... Reversed...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: This mean somethin' bad?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Then lemme just turn it round—

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Stay your hand and do not touch the card!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oh, alright...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sorry, Gitano.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: That's not it.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: The card's position is in relation to the revealer.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: So this card.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Is Upright.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ohh...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Right! Yer sittin' opposite me!!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: So this card mean somethin' good, then?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: In regards to my occupation and personal relations, it's not bad at all.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Then—

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: (Grabs Gitano's hand and rubs it a few times)

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Lemme borrow a li'l bit of yer good luck, a'ight? This way I can pay ya back.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: If you so insist...

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: As you wish, then...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hoooo boy, yer gonna let me pay you back sure as sweeeeeet heck.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I just thoughta somethin'!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: If I'm borrowin' yer good luck, don't that mean the whole divination we just did don't count fer nothin' now?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Who knows?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: So there ain't no rule like that, huh.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: If you want another divination, you will have to make a payment to me again.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Uh, yup. Pass, then.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Lemme rub a few more times. That oughta be free, right?

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Hm-hmm~

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: I'll give you a discount on this one. Free it is.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Aw, thanks!
Five minutes later...

steps.name: Young Studying Operator
steps.text: Hi, Croissant!!

steps.name: Young Studying Operator
steps.text: It's nice to meet you too, Gitano!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oooh.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Good day, all.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Well, then. I'll be leaving now.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: I pray the LMD you earn will be enough to cram Rhodes Island full.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You got it.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Next time ya got stuff to buy, remember, you find me. I'll give ya some deep discounts!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Fate is a thing of constant change. We'll talk details when the time is right.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: (Waves and leaves)

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: (I hope my fortune can truly be of help to you, Croissant.)
